subject: Next Steps on Enterprise Workflow Automation Tender Win
html:
We had a great discussion during our meeting about the recent tender win for enterprise workflow automation. This win is a significant milestone for us, and it's crucial that we deliver a seamless onboarding experience for the new client. We confirmed that onboarding conversations will start next week, and our focus now is on preparing the necessary materials and assigning an internal point of contact. This will ensure a smooth handoff into delivery and set us up for success. The team's efforts in securing this win are a testament to our capabilities, and I'm excited to see this project come to life.

Priya, you're leading the charge on preparing the onboarding materials, while Rohan will assign an internal point of contact for the new account. Once these action items are complete, we'll be ready to kick off the onboarding process. I'll send out a follow-up email next week to confirm the status of these tasks and outline the next steps. If you have any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to reach out to me directly.

Sent by Swytchcode Aurora
